intro: Deathguard Burgess is a Forsaken sentry stationed in the town of Brill within Tirisfal Glades. Standing watch over the settlement, he keeps order and directs travelers to vital services across the hamlet.

p: Positioned in the settlement of Brill just north of the Undercity, Deathguard Burgess serves as one of the town guards maintaining security against the Scourge and Scarlet Crusade. Like other Deathguards throughout Tirisfal Glades, Burgess aids arriving Forsaken by providing directions to local tradesfolk, class trainers, and civic services, keeping the vulnerable outpost running smoothly.
